rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the seven-a-side team sport played on a court.

example.english: I used to play handball with my classmates all the time.
example.traditional: 我細個成日同班同學一齊打手球。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 tung4 baan1 tung4 hok6 jat1 cai4 daa2 sau2 kau4
